events.title: PostReady: PR #628 — Restyle Schedule, Connect Socials and Settings to the create-area design system
events.description: Restyled the Schedule, Connect Socials, and Settings pages to use the same modern design system introduced in the Create page redesign, giving the full app a consistent visual language.

events.title: PostReady: PR #629 — Redesign post-detail page
events.description: Redesigned the post-detail ("Your post is ready") page to match the new create-area design system, giving the full posting flow a consistent visual identity.

events.title: PostReady: PR #630 — Text style panel polish (brand swatch alignment + Placement row)
events.description: Polished the text style panel with improved brand swatch alignment and a cleaner Placement row, refining the typography overlay controls introduced in the Create area redesign.

events.title: PostReady: PR #631 — Cap Schedule post-picker grid at 12 with "Show more"
events.description: Capped the Schedule page's post-picker grid at 12 items and added a "Show more" button, keeping the scheduling flow uncluttered for users with many saved posts.

events.title: PostReady: PR #632 — Fix text style chips always visible + Hook honours accent colour
events.description: Fixed text overlay controls so style chips are always visible, and ensured the Hook text style correctly applies the brand accent colour rather than falling back to default.

events.title: PostReady: PR #633 — Text style panel round 2: artistic accent hint, placement layout, brand swatch ring
events.description: Second pass on the text style panel: added an artistic accent hint, refined the placement layout, and added a brand swatch ring — further polishing the typography overlay controls in the Create area redesign.

events.title: PostReady: PR #634 — Add Clear control to the idea prompt (image + video)
events.description: Added a Clear control to the idea prompt input on both the image and video creation flows, letting users quickly reset their prompt without manually selecting and deleting text.

events.title: PostReady: PR #635 — Remove obsolete PostReady-IG Instagram interstitial
events.description: Removed the interstitial modal shown before the Instagram OAuth handoff — the "PostReady-IG" name explanation step is no longer needed, streamlining the Instagram connect flow.

events.title: PostReady: PR #636 — Redesign post-detail engagement + video cards (Post performance)
events.description: Redesigned the post-detail engagement section and video cards on the Post performance page, giving the analytics view a polished, consistent look aligned with the new design system.

events.title: PostReady: PR #637 — Hover-to-reveal engagement on posted pack cards
events.description: Added hover-to-reveal engagement stats on posted pack cards, surfacing likes, comments, and reach inline without navigating to the full post-detail page.
